fonts.purpose: Formal, timeless elegance for main headings and quotes.
Clean, modern readability for paragraphs and small labels.

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-serif tracking-tighter leading-none
scale.overline: text-xs sm:text-sm font-sans tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-medium

visual_enhancers.textures: Include a fixed, pointer-events-none noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire app to give a tactile, editorial paper feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2DCD0 for structure and bento cards. No heavy drop shadows. Rely on delicate lines to separate sections and create the 'Swiss' minimal grid feel.
visual_enhancers.corners: Slightly rounded (rounded-md to rounded-xl) to maintain friendliness while keeping it formal.

grids_and_layouts.container: Max-width screen-xl mx-auto, generous padding (px-6 md:px-12).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use py-24 to py-32 for section vertical padding to let content breathe.
grids_and_layouts.grid_system: Use asymmetrical grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 for content sections to avoid boring centered alignments (except hero).

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling for a premium, heavy momentum feel.
motion.reveal: Framer Motion staggered line-by-line text reveals (y: 40, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1). Use custom ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] duration: 0.8s.
motion.interactions: Hover states on buttons with accent color fill and subtle scale up. Image parallax on scroll.
motion.festive: Confetti burst from bottom center using 'canvas-confetti' upon clicking the CTA button.

components.cta_button: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), border border-foreground px-6 py-3 font-sans uppercase tracking-widest text-xs hover:bg-accent hover:border-accent hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Slow moving, font-serif, massive text separated by dot or star icons. Background: muted, Text: foreground.
components.chapter_label: Overline text with '01', '02' followed by chapter name. Placed top-left of sections.

image_urls.description: Elegant flower bouquet to visually anchor the message of appreciation in the asymmetrical grid.
Vintage books in bookcase conveying wisdom and the essence of teaching.
Clean, minimal architecture to add visual depth to the footer or transition areas.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
Implement a noise overlay div with pointer-events-none fixed over the entire screen.
Ensure spacing is 2-3x larger than typical UI design. Emphasize negative space.
Avoid generic centered layouts except for the hero statement.
Do not use generic 'transition: all' in CSS. Be specific with transition properties.
Use pure HTML and Tailwind for structural layout; keep it organic and asymmetrical where possible. Do not over-rely on rigid Shadcn Cards.
No absolute transparent backgrounds on headers; if sticky, use backdrop-blur.
Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. If overlaying text on images, use subtle gradient backgrounds.
Follow mobile-first approach meticulously, as users will scan QR codes via their phones.

section_blueprints.hero: 100vh height. Centered layout. Large Serif heading 'Happy Teacher's Day' masked and revealed line-by-line using Framer Motion. A secondary sans-serif subtitle. A button saying 'TAP FOR JOY' that triggers confetti. Background color: #F9F6F0.
section_blueprints.chapter_01_gratitude: Numbered chapter '01. Gratitude'. Asymmetrical grid (md:grid-cols-12). Left column (col-span-12 md:col-span-7): large serif body text explaining gratitude. Right column (col-span-12 md:col-span-4 md:col-start-9): tall elegant image of the flower bouquet with parallax effect.
section_blueprints.chapter_02_quotes: Numbered chapter '02. Wisdom'. Grid layout with bento-style cards (md:grid-cols-2 or 3). Each card has a white background (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border (#E2DCD0). Quote text in serif, author in sans-serif overline format.
section_blueprints.chapter_03_wishes: Numbered chapter '03. Wishes'. This section features the slow editorial marquee strip extending full width. Marquee text: 'THANK YOU • INSPIRATION • GUIDANCE'. Below it, a final message of collective appreciation.
section_blueprints.footer: Massive typography sign-off '[School Name] 2026' (use placeholder 'St. Jude's Academy' or similar). Minimal, elegant, lots of negative space (py-32). Top border 1px solid #E2DCD0.
